offering_description.value: Provides investment management and wealth planning services to high-net-worth individuals, families, trusts, foundations, endowments and institutions. Delivers through in-house investment strategies (equity, fixed income, balanced) plus family office and financial planning services, via advisors in US offices.

primary_services.value: investment management; wealth planning; family office services; fiduciary and trust-related advisory; institutional asset management

customer_segment.value: B2C: high-net-worth individuals and families; B2B: foundations, endowments, trusts, retirement plans and other institutions

end_markets.value: wealth management; asset management; institutional investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: asset-based advisory and management fees on client assets under management; service fees: family office and financial planning fees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: registered investment adviser managing client portfolios for wealthy individuals and institutions

geography_served.value: US national: Offices in New York, Boston, Virginia, Pennsylvania, Texas, California and other US locations, clients mainly in the US

specialization.value: related lines: investment management, wealth planning and family office services for the same client base

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house advisors and relationship managers serving clients directly; own locations: regional advisory offices across the US

regulatory_exposure.value: high: SEC-registered investment adviser under the Investment Advisers Act, fiduciary duties and compliance oversight
